data.name: Bartlett
data.gender_notes: Bartlett is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from Old English 'Beorhthehild' or 'Beorhtred', meaning 'bright' or 'illustrious'. In medieval Europe, 'Bartlett' was a surname for someone who lived near a prominent tree, 'bart', or a clearing, 'let'. The name Bartlett carries the meaning “Bright or Illustrious” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Bartlett usually hope their child will grow to embody bright or illustrious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that represents enlightenment, wisdom, and spiritual growth.
data.etymology: Bartlett belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Bright or Illustrious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bartlett total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_hebrew.name: ברטלט
in_hebrew.meaning: בן של ברתולומאוס, ברכה של אלוהים
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם ברטלט הוא שילוב של השמות העבריים 'בר' ו'תולומאוס', שפירושם 'בן של ברתולומאוס' או 'ברכה של אלוהים'. השם ברתולומאוס מקורו ביוונית ופירושו 'בן תלמי', שם תלמי היה אחד משנים עשר השליחים של ישוע המשיח. השם ברטלט משמש כנראה כצורה הקוצרה של ברתולומאוס, ומשמש ככינוי לאדם שמביא ברכה מאלוהים.

in_greek.name: Βαρθολομαῖος
in_greek.long_meaning: Ὁ Βαρθολομαῖος εἰς τὴν Καινήν Διαθήκην ἀναφέρεται ὡς ἕνας τῶν δώδεκα ἀποστόλων τοῦ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ. Τὸ ὄνομα προέρχεται ἀπὸ τὸ Ἀραμαϊκό 'בר תלמי', τὸ ὁποῖον σημαίνει 'υἱὸς τοῦ Θαλμεαίου'. Ὁ ἀπόστολος Βαρθολομαῖος εἰς τὰ Εὐαγγέλια μνημονεύεται ὡς ὁ ἕνας τῶν μαθητῶν τοῦ Ἰησοῦ, καὶ ὁ ἔνατος τῶν ἀποστόλων εἰς τὴν Ἀποστολικήν Πράξιν.

in_latin.name: Bartlettus
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Bartlettus derivatur ex Hebraeo 'בר תלמי' (Bartholomaeus), quod significat 'filius Bartholomaei' vel 'benedictus a Deo'. Nomen hoc in traditione Christiana Occidentali adhibetur ut cognomen apostoli Bartholomaei, unius ex duodecim apostolis Iesu Christi. Usus nominis Bartletti in cultura Christiana medii aevi originem habet.

in_english.name: Bartlett
in_english.long_meaning: The surname Bartlett is of English origin, derived from the Hebrew name 'בר תלמי' (Bartholomaeus), meaning 'son of Bartholomew' or 'blessed'. The name Bartholomew itself is believed to be derived from the Aramaic 'bar Talmai', meaning 'son of the furrow' or 'son of the plowman'. In Christian tradition, Bartholomew was one of Jesus' twelve apostles. The name Bartlett likely originated as a patronymic surname, meaning 'son of Bartholomew', and was commonly used in medieval England. As a given name, Bartlett is often associated with qualities such as leadership, confidence, and spirituality.
